term: life present at a time (`LivesAt x t`, `lifeStateAt x t`)
definition: In a duration frame (a type of times with an earlier-than relation; no order axiom assumed), `LivesAt x t` says that x's life is present at time t, and `lifeStateAt x t` is the state of that life, including its operations (q.10 a.1 ad 2: duration is attended according to operation). To live is to act from oneself and not as moved by another (q.18 a.3 co.). For what is not in time, presence at t is read with q.10 a.2 ad 4: eternity includes all times.
note: A frame vocabulary, not a defined notion of biological life; it is constrained only by STMT-CHANGE-REQUIRES-POTENCY and STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES. Sourcing it would need a typed reading of q.18 a.1-2 (life as self-motion, life as operation).
